children: Marathon Bancorp, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $11.901M and net income of $1.791M, with diluted earnings per share of $0.66, marking a substantial improvement from FY 2025 driven by higher loan yields and portfolio growth.
Revenue was $11.901M for FY 2026, compared with $9.551M in FY 2025; YoY change 24.6%.
Net income was $1.791M for FY 2026, compared with $0.042M in FY 2025; absolute increase $1.749M.
Diluted EPS was $0.66 for FY 2026, compared with $0.02 in FY 2025.
Net interest income rose 35.8% year over year, supported by higher loan yields and loan portfolio growth that boosted core operating revenue.
Strategic mix shift increased higher-yield lending, with growth in one-to-four-family, multifamily and commercial real estate loans.
Management emphasized relationship-driven deposit growth, expanding demand/NOW and money market balances through new lending relationships.
Operational efficiency efforts include a new core software contract expected to reduce data processing costs and deliver roughly $185K of annual savings.
Funding strategy incorporated increased use of FHLB borrowings to support loan growth while maintaining daily liquidity monitoring.
